title: The Rod and the Breastplate: Aaron of the House of Levi, from the Dust of Egypt to the Cave on Mount Hor
conventions: BCE atlas years '-0100' mean 100 BC; astronomical year = 1 - Y
positions at 0h UT of the civil date; tropical signs of date

birth.segment: The House of Levi in Egypt
birth.stop: Goshen, the birth in the house of Levi
birth.date_confidence: Reconstruction. No verse gives Aaron's birth year or birthplace. The year is arithmetic from the Seder Olam anchor of 1313 BCE for the Exodus, at which Exodus 7:7 makes Aaron 83; the place is inferred from the settlement of Israel in the eastern Delta, and Goshen is a region, not a site. The rival Ramesside chronology would move the birth some hundred years later.
